risks.note: Identified as a material risk in the BRSR: the Company's ability to meet patient needs, create value and build trust is directly linked to the quality and safety of its products, and poor performance in these critical areas can have negative impacts on stakeholders and in turn on the business. Mitigation is a shift from 'Quality for Compliance' to 'Quality as a Culture' across systems, processes, technology and people, with a dedicated Corporate Quality Assurance Group monitoring adherence to defined product quality standards.

Identified as a material risk in the BRSR: PPL is subject to regulations related to bribery, corruption, lobbying and similar areas, and as standards keep changing any non-compliance may result in financial impact and harm to reputation. Mitigated through codes of conduct for board members, senior management, employees, suppliers, vendors and contractors across the value chain.
risks.risk: Business ethics — bribery, corruption and lobbying compliance

risks.note: Identified as a material risk in the BRSR: a data breach within the Company's IT systems can lead to serious business impact and reputational risk, resulting in both financial and non-financial losses, with regulations tightening and awareness rising. Mitigated by a privacy policy governing personal information and by Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) scans reported to IT and application teams.

Identified as a material risk in the BRSR: the Company must stay focused on the needs and wellbeing of patients, customers and consumers as regulations become stricter; addressed through its core principles of Knowledge, Action, Care and Impact and steps to improve engagement and outcomes, with patient centricity as a key priority.
risks.risk: Patient, customer and consumer centricity under tightening regulation

risks.note: Structural concentration disclosed in the BRSR — exports contribute 72.78% of the entity's total turnover and markets served span over 100 countries, so earnings depend on overseas demand, regulatory regimes and currency movements rather than the domestic market.
100% of turnover comes from a single main activity — manufacturing of pharmaceuticals, medicinal, chemical and botanical products — leaving no diversification outside the pharmaceutical cycle.

The permanent-employee turnover rate was 23% in FY2026 (25.50% in FY2025 and 21.94% in FY2024), against a much lower permanent-worker turnover of 5%, indicating sustained churn in the professional workforce that supports a science- and quality-led business.

The Board reports a Risk Management framework to identify, measure, manage and mitigate business risks and opportunities, which helps manage market, credit and operational risks and quantifies potential impact at Company level; details of the risk management process sit in the MD&A.
risks.risk: Market, credit and operational risks managed through the enterprise risk framework
